PREFIX bif: <bif:>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
SELECT ?concept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patient_count) (?is_main AS ?main_procedure) (AVG(?duration) AS ?average_duration)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?procedure a sphn:BilledProcedure ;
               sphn:hasCode ?code .
    ?code a ?concept . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?concept), STR(snomed:)))
    ?procedure sphn:hasAdministrativeCase ?case .
    OPTIONAL { ?case sphn:hasRank ?rank ; sphn-individual:Principal . BIND("yes" AS ?is_main) } .
    OPTIONAL { ?case sphn:hasRank ?rank ; sphn-individual:Supplementary . BIND("no" AS ?is_main) } .
    FILTER(?concept = snomed:89002000)
  }
  BIND(bif:datediff("second", ?procedure/sphn:hasStartDateTime, ?procedure/sphn:hasEndDateTime) AS ?duration)
}
GROUP BY ?concept ?is_main
ORDER BY DESC(?patient_count)
